sources.facts: The README describes permissionless batch liquidation, a 0.0375 WETH reserve per liquidated trove, and collateral compensation limited to the debt fraction offset by its Stability Pool. Pure redistribution has no collateral component. Source description is not deployed runtime or profit proof.
The borrowing FAQ gives the reserve plus capped collateral reward. Its broad formula alone does not establish the partial-offset detail, current eligibility or any particular transaction's proceeds.

batchLiquidateTroves has no caller access gate; it fetches a price, skips inactive or sufficiently collateralized troves, and reverts if no debt is liquidated. It offsets against Stability Pool deposits after leaving the minimum, then redistributes any remainder. Collateral gas compensation uses the offset share of collateral. The Liquidation event precedes transferFrom of WETH from GasPool to msg.sender, then the collateral transfer from ActivePool. The caller need not itself supply the canceled debt in this source path. Transfer logs and public source do not establish native internal payments or runtime equivalence.

Indexed official deployment table supplies the three branch addresses below. Opening this page returned Internal Error; retain addresses as documented leads to validate against actual event and receipt identities, not independent runtime verification.
The interface exposes batchLiquidateTroves(uint256[]), trove enumeration, status and collateral-ratio views. Enumeration is not ordered by liquidation eligibility.

Liquidation has ten non-indexed uint256 fields. Its third field is named boldGasCompensation, but the inspected implementation supplies ETHGasCompensation and pays WETH; do not interpret that name as BOLD cash.
